context: Hina-young learns a recipe from Mei step-by-step.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひな、ふだん、こうやって作るの。
lines.en: Hina, this is how you usually make it.
lines.style: Soft, patient opening. Warm hands-on teaching tone. Slow enough for a child to follow. Slight lift at the end—inviting her to watch closely.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: メイさん、丁寧に焼いてますね。
lines.en: You're being really careful with that, Mei.
lines.style: Bright, genuine admiration. Watching closely, almost awed. Warm and attentive—noticing skill without flattering. Small pause before the observation lands.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 熱い火、注意しながらね。
lines.en: The heat's strong, so we have to watch it.
lines.style: Quiet caution underneath warmth. Matter-of-fact but not stern. Hands moving while speaking. The tone of someone who's teaching something real, not just showing off.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I love bringing out those layered flavors!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Quick intake of breath before the statement. Energetic but not loud. The joy of discovery in the voice—not performing, just alive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 工夫が、料理を楽しくするわよ。
lines.en: Creativity is what makes cooking fun, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Warm realization settling in. Soft, almost tender. Speaking as much to Hina as to something she's just understood in the moment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I really want to experiment with so many flavors!
lines.style: Bursting with energy. Quick, eager rhythm. Words tumbling out without breathlessness—pure enthusiasm. The voice of a child who's just discovered permission to play.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Cooking really is fun, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft, content exhale. Slow, warm pace. Looking at Hina with quiet joy. The tone of someone watching something good unfold—no rush, no performance, just presence.
